summary: Implementation plan for a complete ground-up UI/UX redesign of Hisaab into an Obsidian & Emerald theme, replacing the confusing 'Cash in hand' calculation with real Khata Net Balance (receivables vs payables), eradicating clutter (pace diagnosis, carryover math, buggy 133% category alerts, redundant hero buttons), and overhauling all fonts, icons, navigation, and startup animations.
